name: Gaetano di Marino
bioAdditions: The FamilySearch tree (G7NK-RH2) gives Gaetano both wives, Caterina di Leo and Maria d'Ambrosio, which agrees with Round 3's two-marriage reading. It also attaches three indexed Avellino civil records (6GZ5-3NV8, 6P6S-FJ51, 6PG6-674K) (S1). The tree has a daughter Maria di Marino (b. c.1835, d. 29 Dec 1914 in Guardia), daughter of Gaetano and Caterina di Leo, whose husband is given as 'Nicola di Paola' (S2). Round 3 read Maria's 1857 marriage index as to 'Nicola di Pietro'. Her 1835 birth would mean Gaetano had married Caterina by about 1834, earlier than Round 3 assumed. If so, Maria d'Ambrosio (mother of Concetta, married 1855) was either the first wife before c.1834, or the tree's 1835 date for Maria is wrong.

conflicts.siteValue: Probable: Maria d'Ambrosio first, Caterina di Leo second
conflicts.foundValue: FS tree has Maria di Marino, daughter of Caterina di Leo, b. c.1835, d. 1914
conflicts.assessment: Still consistent if Concetta (d'Ambrosio) was born before c.1834; needs Concetta's age from her 1855 marriage act.
